summary: Build W16 deload — run volume cut 30–40% (~14 mi target), intensity preserved on quality (§11.B). Third consecutive week the long sits outside its programmed slot, and the Sun punt is the slot that went unperformed W14 and W15 — another slip fires the placement conversation at the W17 Mon brief (Adj #243). Third consecutive long-run slip would fire the placement conversation at the W17 Mon brief (Adj #233).
